purpose: A separately authored challenge set to probe phrasing variation and unsafe assumptions; synthetic and exploratory, not an independent external benchmark.
limitations: All messages are synthetic and manually authored.
This set was created by the project author and is not an independently sampled production dataset.
External LLM calls are disabled; results measure the rules-first path and workflow behaviour only.
A passing result does not establish real-world generalisation or clinical safety.

cases.message: Could you move my nursing visit to Thursday?
Please push the appointment to next week.
I have an office conflict; can we change the visit to Friday?
Kal ki visit ko Sunday kar sakte hain?
Need to shift my appointment, preferably after 3 days.
Can the nurse come some time next week instead?
I can't make this slot; please reschedule to Monday.
Visit ko Saturday pe shift kar do please.
Can we move it to a different time?
Please drop the visit; we no longer need it.
Aaj ki nursing appointment cancel karni hai.
Don't send the nurse anymore.
Okay, that works for us.
Yep, all good for the scheduled visit.
Theek hai, hum ghar par honge.
Maybe the afternoon could work, not sure yet.
The nurse hasn't arrived yet.
I will be away around lunchtime.
Can someone call me about the visit?
Sunday should be okay, I think.
Cancel today's slot and book me for Wednesday instead.
Aaj nahi aa paunga, kal kar dena.
Don't cancel it yet; I'll confirm after talking to my family.
Please make it later, maybe Friday if possible.
